_comment: Example fleet configuration for the Reach bridge (see README.md, 'Fleet mode'). JSON has no comments, so this note rides in a field the bridge ignores. Copy this file to fleet-config.json in a private location — never commit the real one. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_CONSOLE_DEVICE_ID with the console device ID of that holding's phone. API keys are NOT stored here: give each phone its own scoped key (platform/create-key.py) and pass it to the bridge as PHONEUSE_API_KEY. Device inventory is PENDING at the time of writing (2026-11-13): every device_id below is a placeholder, and the bridge refuses to run a holding whose device_id is still the placeholder.
